purpose: screen finite-Red Lancer+age-80 non-investigation branches for repeated observable and actionable problems; this is not a policy comparison

seed_audit.result: free at freeze time; 8285-8286 excluded after short preflight smokes

coverage_miss.definition: at least one owned host has no completed Analyse by episode end

recovery_failure.definition: a completed Remove or Restore reports simulator result FALSE

verification_opportunity.definition: a completed verification Analyse leaves Blue belief VERIFY or UNKNOWN while at least two distinct eligible verification hosts were present at that decision

screening_criteria.decision: A criterion only earns a follow-up development study; it is not evidence that the current policy is inferior. If multiple criteria qualify, do not train until one target and objective are frozen separately.

limits: No training or held-out performance claim
No seed overrides; use a new study config for another block
Unresolved belief is not a clean-host label or proof of policy failure
Simulator action completion and Blue belief are reported separately
